edits.after: She pokes the bird — feather the margins, dodge the root, and entrance the rotation gap once.

edits.before: Lux wins by landing Light Binding, denying your pattern, and out-chipping the 2v2 until your windows close.
edits.after: Lux wins by landing Light Binding, then free-casting Lucent Singularity and an Illumination-primed auto while you're rooted — the 10s Q cooldown is her only downtime.

edits.before: Commit on Light Binding’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. His answer goes first; yours goes last.
edits.after: Commit on Light Binding’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Her answer goes first; yours goes last.

edits.before: - Lux Light Binding: matchup-defining — Everything keys off the root — minion-block it and the combo never starts. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E Battle Dance answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Light Binding (Q) is a flat 10s cooldown at every rank — a whiff or a Q spent on your carry means 10 clean seconds to step up. - Prismatic Barrier (W) absorbs your burst; force it before you commit. - Final Spark (R) needs a channel and is 60/50/40s — charm her mid-channel and it's wasted.

edits.before: Level 2-3 windows govern; level 6 hardens the playbook; first item funds it.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are her Q-E combo; level 3's W-E gapclose flips it; level 6's charm beats her 60s R channel; first item punishes every 10s Q whiff.

edits.before: Zone with the threat — the button you hold governs more than the one you press.
edits.after: Light Binding roots for her full combo and Lucent Singularity zones your walk-up before level 3 — hold Battle Dance to peel, not engage, until W-E can vault her zone.

edits.before: Window economy: convert the ganks, start the rivers, peel the picks.
edits.after: Bait the Q, then W-dash the instant its 10s cooldown starts — a whiffed Light Binding leaves her with only Lucent Singularity to answer your engage.

edits.before: Carry by windows — one clean play per fight; your carry does the arithmetic.
edits.after: Carry by converting a whiffed Q into a flank charm — Grand Entrance into The Quickness lands before her 60/50/40s Final Spark finishes channeling.

edits.before: You decide the fights your team attends — start them, peel them, or poke them out of existence.
edits.after: Flank through Lucent Singularity's zone — once Grand Entrance-Quickness lands she has no dash and Illumination's auto-reset is her only remaining follow-up.

edits.before: Ahead, dance louder: entrance Lux's carry off every window and charm the recovery formations.
edits.after: Ahead, hunt the cooldown: track Light Binding's 10s timer and Final Spark's channel, charm her the moment either is down — she has no dash to answer it.

edits.before: Q the pair for the heal, W the window, E home — the trade paid twice and answered once.
edits.after: Q the pair for the heal, wait out her Q's 10s cooldown, then W the window and E home — the trade paid twice and answered once.

edits.before: Entrancing into a banked disengage — the bird that flies into tornadoes writes the highlight for the other team.
edits.after: W-dashing into a banked Light Binding — her root plus Lucent Singularity punishes an entrance harder than it ever pays back.

edits.before: Q the pair for the heal, W the window, E home — the trade paid twice and answered once.
